newsitem.title: USA: Aydin Corp sees $1.2 mln gain in Q2.
newsitem.headline: Aydin Corp sees $1.2 mln gain in Q2.

text.p: Aydin Corp said Tuesday that it expects to record a gain of $1.2 million in the second quarter as a result of the sale of two company-owned office buildings.
The company said that there is also an agreement for a third property to be sold, but did not disclose what the impact of that sale might be.

Aydin added that the consolidation of operations into fewer buildings has allowed it to combine manufacturing operations and consolidate several product lines, which will yield operational cost savings.
After posing a loss in the first quarter of $4.3 million, largely due to an unfavorable court ruling, the company said it expects to profitable in the second quarter.
